Auxiliary Links

You can add a list of auxiliary links to your site, shown at the top right on all pages. You do this by including the aux_links configuration option in your site’s _config.yml file.

Example Auxiliary Link

This website has an auxiliary link: “Just the Docs on GitHub”. It is rendered with the following code:

aux_links:
  Just the Docs on GitHub:
    - https://github.com/just-the-docs/just-the-docs
